text: Time [governs] the five elements; Time destroys the world. Time remains awake while others sleep; for Time is indeed insurmountable. There are three entities: the manifest, the unmanifest, and the Purusha. Time is included within them. It is manifest because it is the agent of all. Even for Time, Pradhana (primordial nature) is the cause. Its inherent nature is also merged herein; therefore, Time is not the cause.
